name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.

name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spells you control to the GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.

name: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 Fiend monsters. Each time your opponent Normal Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 "Phantasm Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 1000/DEF 1000), but it cannot declare an attack. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; this card gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's original ATK, until the end of this turn.

name: Elemental HERO Neo Bubbleman
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending an "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and "Metamorphosis" in your hand to the Graveyard. This card's name is treated as "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" while it is face-up on the field. Destroy an opponent's monster that battles this card at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Hero Kid
desc: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "Hero Kid"(s) from your Deck.

name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

name: Cyber Laser Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

name: Ancient Gear
desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position.

name: Ancient Gear Cannon
desc: You can Tribute this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn.

name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
desc: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field.

name: Adhesive Explosive
desc: Before damage calculation, if this card was attacked by an opponent's monster and was in face-down Defense Position at the start of the Damage Step: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase, destroy the monster this card is equipped to.

name: Machine King Prototype
desc: This card gains 100 ATK and DEF for each Machine-Type monster on the field, except this card.

name: B.E.S. Covered Core
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 2 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, at the end of the Damage Step toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, remove 1 counter. If this card battles without a counter, destroy it at the end of the Damage Step.

name: D.D. Guide
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, give control of it to your opponent. During each player's End Phase, your opponent selects 1 card from the Graveyard of this card's controller and removes it from play.

name: Chain Thrasher
desc: This card can attack 1 additional time during the same Battle Phase for each "Chain Thrasher" in your Graveyard.

name: Disciple of the Forbidden Spell
desc: When this card is Summoned, declare different Monster Card Attributes equal to the number of "Disciple of the Forbidden Spell"(s) in your Graveyard. If this card attacks a monster that has a declared Attribute, destroy the monster with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

name: Tenkabito Shien
desc: This card is unaffected by the effects of Trap Cards.

name: Parasitic Ticky
desc: The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of tokens on the field x 500.

name: Gokipon
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can add 1 Insect monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

name: Silent Insect
desc:
If this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: Change this card to Defense Position. Negate the effects on the field of Continuous Spells/Traps.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Chainsaw Insect
desc: If this card battled, at the end of the Damage Step: Your opponent draws 1 card.

name: Anteatereatingant
desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Saber Beetle
desc: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Doom Dozer
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 Insect monsters from your GY. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

name: Treeborn Frog
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spell/Trap Cards to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Beelze Frog
desc: This card gains 300 ATK for each "T.A.D.P.O.L.E." in your Graveyard.

name: Princess Pikeru
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Trial of the Princesses". During your Standby Phase, gain 800 Life Points for each monster you control.

name: Princess Curran
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Trial of the Princesses". During your Standby Phase, inflict 600 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

name: Memory Crusher
desc: If this card successfully attacks directly, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Extra Deck.

name: Malice Ascendant
desc: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard for each "Malice Ascendant" in your Graveyard. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Grass Phantom
desc: This card gains 500 ATK for each "Grass Phantom" in your Graveyard.

name: Sand Moth
desc: If this face-down Defense Position card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon it and switch its original ATK/DEF.

name: Divine Dragon - Excelion
desc:
When this card is Normal Summoned, it gets 1 of the following effects for each "Divine Dragon - Excelion" in your Graveyard when this effect resolves (your choice). These effects cannot accumulate.
● This card gains 1000 ATK.
● If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.
● When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Ruin, Queen of Oblivion
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". When this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can activate this effect; this card can make a second attack in a row.

name: Demise, King of Armageddon
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". You can pay 2000 LP; destroy all other cards on the field.

name: D.3.S. Frog
desc:
"Des Frog" + "Des Frog" + "Des Frog"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. This card gains 500 ATK for each "Treeborn Frog" in your Graveyard.

name: Hero Heart
desc: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control; halve its ATK until the end of this turn, but it can attack twice during this turn's Battle Phase.

name: Magnet Circle LV2
desc: Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Machine-Type monster from your hand.

name: Ancient Gear Factory
desc: Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, then banish a number of "Ancient Gear" monsters from your Graveyard, whose combined Levels are double the revealed monster's, and if you do, if you Normal Summon the revealed monster this turn, you must Normal Summon it without Tributing.

name: Ancient Gear Drill
desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear" monster: Discard 1 card; Set 1 Spell Card directly from your Deck. This turn, that Spell Card cannot be activated.

name: Phantasmal Martyrs
desc: While you have at least 2 other cards in your hand, and control "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" or "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder": Send your entire hand to the GY; Special Summon 3 "Phantasmal Martyr Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Attack Position.

name: Cyclone Boomerang
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Wildheart". It gains 500 ATK. When the equipped monster is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field, then inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each Spell/Trap Card destroyed by this effect.

name: Symbol of Heritage
desc: Activate only while there are 3 Monster Cards with the same name in your Graveyard. Select 1 of those monsters, Special Summon it, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Trial of the Princesses
desc: Equip only to "White Magician Pikeru" or "Ebon Magician Curran"; it gains 800 ATK. During a turn that the equipped monster destroyed a Level 5 or higher monster by battle, you can Tribute the equipped monster and this card to Special Summon from your hand or Deck: 1 "Princess Pikeru" if you Tributed "White Magician Pikeru", or 1 "Princess Curran" if you Tributed "Ebon Magician Curran".

name: Photon Generator Unit
desc: Tribute 2 "Cyber Dragons". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Laser Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: End of the World
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

name: Ancient Gear Castle
desc: All "Ancient Gear" monsters gain 300 ATK. Each time a monster is Normal Summoned/Set, place 1 counter on this card. If you Tribute Summon an "Ancient Gear" monster face-up, you can Tribute this card instead, if the number of its counters is equal to or greater than the number of required Tribute(s).

name: Samsara
desc: Monster Cards Tributed for a Ritual Summon are returned to the owner's Deck instead of being sent to the Graveyard.

name: Super Junior Confrontation
desc: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate the battle, and 1 monster with the lowest ATK in face-up Attack Position your opponent controls battles against 1 monster with the lowest DEF in face-up Defense Position you control. After that battle, end the Battle Phase.

name: Miracle Kids
desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; that target loses 400 ATK for each "Hero Kid" in your Graveyard, until the End Phase.

name: Attack Reflector Unit
desc: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

name: Damage Condenser
desc: When you take battle damage: Discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the battle damage you took, in Attack Position.

name: Karma Cut
desc:
Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; banish that target, then, if there are any card(s) with the same name in your opponent's GY, banish them.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Next to be Lost
desc: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard with the same name as the selected card.

name: Generation Shift
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy that target, then add 1 card with the same name as the destroyed card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Full Salvo
desc: When this card resolves, send your entire hand to the Graveyard. Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card you sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

name: Success Probability 0%
desc: Send 2 random Fusion Monsters from your opponent's Extra Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Option Hunter
desc: Activate only when a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Goblin Out of the Frying Pan
original_name: Goblin Out of the Frying Pan
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and return it to the owner's hand.

name: Malfunction
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its original position.
